name: ghuron-skills
description: Agent skills for Dutch everyday services: Magister (school), OVpay and HTM (public transport), Budget Thuis (energy), ABN AMRO (bank exports), Albert Heijn (grocery invoices) and Epson printer ink.

plugins.name: magister
plugins.description: Magister school portal: timetable with homework and tests, grades, absences, messages, and reporting a child sick.

plugins.name: ovpay
plugins.description: OVpay (Dutch public transport): cards, balances and trip history with fares, and CSV export.

plugins.name: htm
plugins.description: HTM (Den Haag public transport): passes, products, trips, Regio Vrij advice, and renewing a product into the cart.

plugins.name: budgetthuis
plugins.description: Budget Thuis energy (electricity and gas): tariffs, contract, monthly instalment and advice, invoices with PDF download, and hourly, daily or monthly usage with costs.

plugins.name: abn-amro
plugins.description: ABN AMRO transaction export (.TAB) to a clean CSV with counterparty, IBAN and description split out.

plugins.name: ah
plugins.description: Albert Heijn online-order invoices (PDF) to one CSV per order, line by line.

plugins.name: epson
plugins.description: Ink cartridge levels of an Epson Expression XP-series network printer.
